iso.help: Download the installation ISO for a release if it is not already there.

package.help: Convert an existing build result into an ESXi-compatible OVA.

template.help: Build the template(s): Windows Setup, VMware Tools, updates, Sysprep, OVA.

publish.help: Release finished template(s) into out\ with volumes, checksum and fact sheet.

upload-ivanti.help: Upload the transfer volumes to the Ivanti file portal, one file at a time.

claude-plugins.help: Install the Claude Code plugins declared in the manifest's `claude` section; idempotent.

completion.help: Regenerate the product's shell completion from its manifest (--check reports drift and writes nothing).

completion-check.help: Report whether deploy\completions\swi.bash still agrees with swi.yaml.

config.help: Show the effective configuration of a release, as the build will use it.

doctor.help: Check that the tools a build needs are installed.

esxi.help: Report the ESXi target for #20: what is configured, what is missing. Writes nothing.

files.help: List what would be transferred for a release.

inspect.help: Report how the page in an already-open browser builds its upload.

install.help: Provision the host tooling the kernel needs - today oras; idempotent.

reset.help: Stop VMs left by an aborted build and clear this release's scratch area.

workflows.help: Regenerate the product's GitHub workflows from its manifest (--check reports drift and writes nothing).

auth-scopes.help: Grant the stored gh token the package scopes GHCR needs (interactive, idempotent).

prune-branches.help: Delete local branches already merged into main (squash-aware via gh).

submodules.help: git submodule update --init lib/platform (init the submodule a fresh worktree needs).

catalogue.help: List the task coordinates the delivery kernel offers, marking the namespaces this product's commands reach.

generate.help: Regenerate the product's CLI module from its manifest (--check reports drift and writes nothing).

accept.help: Run every declared suite in order, then render the Allure archive.

artefact.help: Check a published OVA and the fact sheet beside it. Reads the file; boots nothing.

iso.help: Report which ISO is present for a release and whether its checksum is cached.

published.help: Report what is in out\ for a release and what is missing. Writes nothing.

report.help: Merge the suites' results and render the single-file Allure archive.

unit.help: Run the unit suite: the seams where swi.yaml becomes configuration. No VM.
